evidence_type: Implementation-only published release check, headless native UI and independent loopback HTTP controls

tests.ui: Actual egui release card with an injected check. Idle and fixture states made no calls. A user action started a failing job, retry returned a prerelease, and View release emitted one official browser URL.
tests.http: Loopback HTTP. Verified GET, no credentials or cookies, official link construction, empty results, malformed and draft entries, oversized body, status failure and refused redirects.

limits: The online check reads public release metadata. The caller explicitly opens a browser to view release notes and assets.
Automatic checks, binary installation, signature verification for updates, rollback and exact installed prerelease identity remain open.
The headless UI interaction uses an injected result. The real GitHub request was verified separately via the production CLI. Whole-product and visual parity remain open.
